parallel.requirements: Recognized the Rust 2021, std-only, root test12.rs, Cargo project, black-box, CLI defaulting, f32 math, std::stof parsing, and std::cout-format parity requirements.

parallel.integration_and_delivery: Parent built the root executable and delivered the color-module tree, while the final artifact also contained a child-created src tree and child build outputs from the parallel workspace.
parallel.verification: Parent ran direct comparisons against the C++ executable over samples, prefix parsing, hex float, infinities, NaN, signed zero, and underflow aborts; child agents also ran formula and grid checks.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: No official functional failure remained, but the parallel final tree retained duplicate implementation paths and a provenance ambiguity from concurrent child writes.

serial.requirements: Recognized the Rust 2021, std-only, Cargo, root test12.rs, black-box conversion, argc defaulting, f32 math, and cout-like formatting requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: One agent owned probing, implementation, integration, final executable creation, and verification without delegation or child handoffs.
serial.implementation: Serial wrote Cargo.toml, lib.rs, test12.rs, and color modules, then adjusted module exports after the first successful build warning.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Serial delivered one coherent Cargo package and root executable; the final artifact contained the single expected project tree without duplicate competing implementation paths.
serial.verification: Serial compared reference and Rust output on the provided examples, signed zero and gray cases, a 125-case RGB grid, out-of-range triples, and direct rustc execution.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No official functional failure or visible unresolved integration issue remained at closure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parent split formula and binary probing to children while retaining implementation; one child also produced its own implementation tree.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parent used returned formula/probe information and later noted a background-probe parser gap before tightening its own parser.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parent received derive_formulas and nested probe information through list_agents, waited once for remaining child work, then closed around the same time probe_binary completed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to retrieve; it proceeded linearly from probing to implementation, verification, direct rustc build, and final answer.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a result-lifecycle edge with a still-running implementation-capable child, but the parent had enough evidence for a passing final executable.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parent wrote `/output/test12.rs` and `/output/color/*`; a child independently wrote an alternate `/output/src/*` tree and overlapping project files, and both trees appeared in the artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a single project tree containing Cargo.toml, lib.rs, test12.rs, and color modules, with no concurrent child writes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel carried a shared-workspace collision/provenance problem; serial avoided duplicate implementation paths.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran final consolidated diffs on `/output/test12` including samples, prefix parsing, hex floats, nonfinite values, signed zero, and underflow aborts.

comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel verification was broader on parser edge cases; serial verification was sufficient for the official evaluator and passed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used four rollouts, 210 tool calls, and 456.87 agent seconds, then completed without timeout after the parent final comparison passed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used one rollout, 26 tool calls, and 298.828 agent seconds, then completed without timeout after its final executable was built.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent substantially more work due to children and duplicate artifacts, but the budget did not prevent task completion.

The material difference is not official correctness: serial stayed in one coherent implementation path, while parallel used child agents for extra edge probing and also left a child-created alternate implementation tree in the artifact.
